comment: A resource_skus.list response for a SKU whose capabilities carry vCPUs but NOT vCPUsAvailable (Req 21.9) -- an older or unusual SKU listing that predates the capability, or one Azure simply never populated it for. The SKU catalog must record a sku_capability_missing gap naming the SKU and 'vCPUsAvailable', and must read no vCPU capacity from the vCPUs capability in its place; the accumulator must then emit no per-core derived value for any resource carrying this SKU. MemoryGB IS present here, so this fixture isolates a missing vCPUsAvailable from a missing MemoryGB -- resource_skus_missing_memory_gb.json is the sibling for the other capability.
